clauses.title: DEFINITIONS
clauses.text:
DEFINITIONS
“Confidential Information” means all information disclosed by one party to the other…
“Deliverables” means the reports, software, documentation and other materials…

“Confidential Information” means all information disclosed by one party to the other, whether orally, in writing or by any other means, that is designated as confidential or that ought reasonably to be regarded as confidential.
clauses.body_text: “Confidential Information” means all information disclosed by one party to the other, whether orally, in writing or by any other means, that is designated as confidential or that ought reasonably to be regarded as confidential.

clauses.text: “Deliverables” means the reports, software, documentation and other materials produced by the Supplier in the course of providing the Services.
clauses.body_text: “Deliverables” means the reports, software, documentation and other materials produced by the Supplier in the course of providing the Services.

clauses.text: The Supplier shall provide the Services with reasonable skill and care and in accordance with each Statement of Work.

clauses.text: If the Supplier delays a Phase, then either the payments shall be postponed or the liability and termination provisions shall apply, at the Customer's election.
